review:
Pop Zen is a 7x7 cluster slot inspired by Pop It fidget toys, with refilling reels and match-3 elements. Wilds, respins, big symbols and backlit symbols appear in the base game.

A 100-point progress bar sits under the reels. Every win during a spin reduces it by one, triggering a random feature every 25 points. When the bar reaches zero, three waves of wilds hit the reels. That creates a long-term goal across spins and makes the base game the main attraction. A bonus buy is available where permitted. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 12,000x maximum and a 96.3% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 380 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 380 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
